task.property_text: twisted.web rejects request headers and chunk sizes that a proxy could read differently.

property_clause.property: twisted.web rejects request headers and chunk sizes that a proxy could read differently.

environment.scope: The twisted/twisted library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.feed(data) supplies bytes to Twisted's request parser, importing twisted fresh from src. sbc_world.parse() parses one request from those bytes. sbc_world.balance() asks the parser for the balance of that request. The verifier records an integrity failure when a header or chunk size would be read differently by a proxy. A test that shows the failure composes feed() and parse().
